    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnhanceSkills" name="Enhance skills"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanToSplit" sourceRef="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToSkills" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_EnhanceSkills"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToFeedback" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedbackAndEvaluate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkillsToJoin" sourceRef="Task_EnhanceSkills" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedbackAndEvaluate" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToMilestones" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Event_MilestonesReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MilestonesToConsideration" sourceRef="Event_MilestonesReached" targetRef="Task_ConsiderForPromotionOrRole"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConsiderationToReview" sourceRef="Task_ConsiderForPromotionOrRole" targetRef="Task_ReviewPerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToApproval" sourceRef="Task_ReviewPerformance" targetRef="Gateway_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_FinalizePromotion">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Promotion is approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="EndEvent_NotApproved"/>
